zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73O 的全部 131 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。
en: This page preserves, from R0.61 through R0.73O, all 131 nodes. R0.61–R0.69W progresses from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, the critical ledger, the internal entry boundary, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B addresses strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I successively treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer to a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, planar fixed-distance departure, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies an inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closes a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then selects the seed using the full action and closes two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance departure at a fixed physical time. The background changes with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit remains in the exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional effects, singularity, and Clay are not extrapolated. R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) while the background changes with it, planar perturbations scaled down according to the full action can retain order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: any coexisting strong solution obeys finite accumulated-strain control; planar perturbations obey a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; sufficiently small full three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie inside a positive stability tube of global strong solutions. Thus the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on a fixed background. R0.73O rules out the \(H^3\)-small instability route around known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, its accumulated \(H^4\) action is finite, and it has a positive stability radius valid for every starting time. The forced contrast retains infinite accumulated strain and supplies, through planar directions, globally smooth witnesses whose initial perturbations tend to zero in \(H^3\), while their \(L^2\) distance from the forced equilibrium is bounded below by a fixed positive constant at suitable times.

The unforced theorem assumes that the reference orbit is already global; the forced example concerns a different equation. Full three-dimensional L2-only input, finite-time singularity, and global regularity for arbitrary initial data remain OPEN.
